creators.name: CMH Gourmand — long-running Columbus & central-Ohio food blog
creators.followers: Established Columbus food blog running since ~2007; recurring central-Ohio dining track record
creators.credible: One of central Ohio's longest-running independent food blogs (since ~2007), a recognized voice on the Columbus dining scene with a deep archive of on-the-ground restaurant write-ups. Findable content at a named mid-corridor place: 'Ann and Tony's, West Jefferson Italian' (cmhgourmand.com/2009/11/30/ann-and-tonys-west-jefferson-italian/). Blog/track-record creator, not a follower-count viral account; corroboration, not lone authority.
